images.filename: Indian Halibut Fishers on Neah Bay, Washington (c. 1900).jpg
images.caption: Original caption: "Indian Halibut Fishers on Neah Bay, Washington." Given the location, I presume these are Makah people.
images.alt: Original caption: "Indian Halibut Fishers on Neah Bay, Washington." Given the location, I presume these are Makah people.
images.artist: Listed as "S.E. Morse of Port Angeles, Washington", but inscription on photo looks like probably "S.G. Morse". Since there is apparently a book called Portrait in Time: Photographs of the Makah by Samuel G. Morse, 1897-1903,, that is presumably the author (and date). Samuel G. Morse was an Indian Agent with Neah Bay in his jurisdiction.
